request: 磨き進めて　次候補とかも

authorization.question: 次候補の「安波節・赤田首里殿内・谷茶前節」に、出典と節を確認できた伝承歌詞（まず1番と伝承の囃子）を収録してよいですか？

decisions.title: 安波節
decisions.delivery: Native equal-beat honchoshi first stanza, lyrics/readings/original meanings and microphone/guide/manual following
sources: https://ks-sanshin.com/youtubeチャンネルに「安波節」を追加しました♪～歌/
decisions.beginner: Slow traditional contour, no new tuning. Practice a sung line before the whole stanza.
decisions.excluded: Small ornaments, vocal Hari fillers, teacher layout/translation/recording and later stanzas.

decisions.title: 赤田首里殿内
decisions.delivery: Teacher video score plus first-stanza/refrain reading companion; manual lyric-line navigation
decisions.beginner: Repetitive hand-play song. The teacher version may use a different tuning; confirm it before playing.
decisions.excluded: Native note-by-note transcription and video time cues remain unverified. Do not infer honchoshi finger positions from the comparison score.

decisions.title: 谷茶前節
decisions.delivery: Teacher video score plus first-stanza/refrain reading companion; manual lyric-line navigation
decisions.beginner: After the slow songs; use the teacher slow-play and5/10second repeat.
decisions.excluded: Native note-by-note transcription and exact lyric time cues remain unverified. Do not include the Ikei Hanari connection, later modern lyrics or source translation.

recordings_images: Comparison only, none bundled. External music-research download data was not used. One v42 public comparison PDF host no longer resolves; alternative university and teacher sources are recorded.
